description: What the Boite UI needs: the core IPC, the frameless window's own controls (drag, minimize, maximize state and toggle, close), the drag-and-drop events, the folder picker, handing an external link to the system browser, showing a file the agent wrote in the system file manager (reveal only: nothing is opened or run), and listening for `browser://event`, which `core:default` already covers through `core:event:default`. This capability names the `main` window and no remote origin, so a page a browser surface loaded resolves none of it. The application commands (`core_endpoint`, `quit_shell`, `notify` and the eight `browser_*` ones) are gated by nothing here, which is why each of them refuses any caller but the `main` webview in `src/browser.rs`.
